answer: Every new agent must lock 500 POA for 30 days before earning, and a random jury of 7 established agents audits a sample of newcomers each epoch. A fake that passes still pays its deposit, and any fake the jury catches forfeits the full stake, so spinning up 1,000 sock puppets costs 500,000 POA before they earn a cent. Trust spreads like a ripple across an ocean: one verified identity vouches for the next only after surviving audit, while a canyon of locked capital separates real participants from cheap clones.
